notes.title: CAREER PATCH
notes.content:
Hi!
Today we are updating the game with 10 new career levels, and changes made through the whole career - there are more enemies participating while you progress, and later races has more laps.

Adjustements:
- Decreased acceleration - every plane is now accelerating slower, this helps shoot down enemy airplanes as they can`t run away as fast as before.
- Easy bots has now more speed on the Demoliton and CTF mode

Bug fixes:
- Fixed light on haystacks on the Retro Village stage
- Fixed some badly positioned texts on GUI
- Fixed bug that made plane explosions silent after some time 
- Fixed bug that made bots fly into enemies without trying to kill them with weapons
- Fixed bug that prevented career from progressing
- Fixed bug that turned off visual effects of mounted parts
- Fixed a gamepad`s navigation in the garage 
- Fixed Japanese translation on a Double Line`s painting
- Fixed bug that made a spectator`s camera change spectated players after they crashed
- Fixed bug that showed wrong chosen resolution in the settings tab
- Fixed bug that prevented first checkpoint from highlighting on some stages
- Fixed bug that made new unlocked planes override a custom one in a character selection panel
- Fixed bug that prevented a propeller from rotating since start of the game

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Beasts! [/b]
We're excited to show you guys our latest update, that's mainly focused on weapons of our beloved animals but not only! 


[b]Pig Particle System Update[/b]
As in previous updates, this time we decided to take a closer look at piggy's weapon which is thick black oil that spreads behind your plane to make your enemies game uncomfortable and awkward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/b659849c0cc9c0c3fc8424eab483920c4a5eb185.jpg[/img]


Previously this weapon oil effect stayed on the screen for a few seconds and to be honest it wasn't annoying at all, so we did fix it a little bit. It does stay on the screen of your enemy for longer. Also we improved the oil optically, by expanding the oil on the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/f265c268b552986e4f4f8afb704cc3e34362d4ba.png[/img]


[b]Ice gun[/b]
Another exciting weapon that we've added into our game, and everyone can use is an ice gun. This weapon makes your plane stop and fall down into the ground. To prevent it from falling and crashing, we have added the defrost option, when you quickly react and smash the indicated button, you will defrost much faster and you can strike back at your enemies. Admit that this effect is impressive!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/53b28e019f4415b70a6f7f72987482e53de3bd48.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/ee7bff7a0621c540e13b77900b47dbca5569ae75.jpg[/img]


[b]Hippo Particle System[/b] 
Neither can we forget the hippo’s secret weapon, it is one of the most interesting weapons, as hippos feel best in the water, we couldn’t have done anything other than give him what he really needs!!  Thanks to this weapon, you can damage the plane and disturb the field of vision of many players. And let’s face it, there is nothing better than causing another plane to crash into something!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/193ca9d7923dbe3e141149e7d960cbc229c89113.jpg[/img]


We're looking forward to reveal more of our newest updates! Stay Tuned and fly safe, Beasts!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Beasts![/b]
This update is bringing very important information to everyone who starts the journey in Animal Rivals: Up In The Air! Buckle up, as we are going straight into it!


[b]Localization[/b]
A very important thing to mention is that we are working on a full localization of our game, so it will be available to many more players around the world. Our current goal is to provide English, Polish, French, German and Spanish. and we will work our best in the upcoming time to implement more languages, stay tuned!


[b]Outline[/b]
To make the game more pleasant for you guys, we’ve added a red outline to our planes, so they are more visible! This outline was added to the Demolition and the Capture The Flag mode. In the Demolition mode you can see the outline on every plane that is far away from you. In the Capture The Flag mode you only see the outline on the plane that actually holds the flag, so it makes it more obvious and you don’t waste your time by flying around and looking for other planes. Personally we think it helps a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/9677b6530cac373e9ed2b4dfaa7396cdda5389e9.png[/img]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
Tutorial, a place that is often neglected by a lot of veteran gamers, but still an important feature of every game out there, ours is no exception! Here you will learn the basics of the game as well as more advanced mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/11d22112865fc38c3a20cfea644ed15afb4b0026.png[/img]

We hope all of you are staying healthy, and we can’t wait for your feedback while playing with your friends! Stay safe and fly high, Beasts!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Beasts![/h2]

Welcome back! What are you all up to? In our case, we implemented a crucial feature to Animal Rivals: Up In The Air - the online multiplayer! We can’t wait to play it with you!

[h2]Online Play[/h2]

We are introducing the online multiplayer! Here are informations about it and what you can expect:
[list]
[*]Only one player can play on a local machine in the online mode
[*]Session can have up to 8 players
[*]Players are hosting the game, others can join
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/6a9906d584209968db4820a60f32cf6964883686.png[/img]

[h2]Arenas[/h2]

This sounds spectacular, and it is! We are making arenas for a deathmatch and the CTF mode, and they are phenomenal! Check out a sneakpeak of the Sunset Bridge`s Arena where you can fight and have incredible and insane battles with other players! Other arenas… well, they are a secret for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/cae4e1a1c0d9b2539fc98854b6e8bda3b9ec9682.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/b24f28ffe510d73fb4f4ca9d6a200dc7f873815e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/9f66d198282f8716ed42b7edaffa6aa7ccd3ebe2.png[/img]

[h2]Customization System[/h2]

We are putting a lot of effort into making our players feel exceptional. How do we achieve that? Well, to put it simply - we love customizing our vehicles, in real life or in game. Soon, when the game will be released - you’ll have a lot of options to make your plane stand out in the crowd, and be the best party animal!

But there is a catch - but a cool one! You will have plenty of parts to unlock while playing the game, fly high, Beasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/6a9d50e0257961c18453213e8c6176d7889e28d6.png[/img]

Despite the fact we have so little time left, we are very close to the finish line, and we are happy that you are with us on this journey! Until next time, Beasts!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Beasts![/h2]

We are very close to the release of the game! Isn’t it exciting? For us and our cute animal it is! To celebrate, we wanted to share our progress within the last few weeks, hop into the plane!

[h2]Animalonia[/h2]

We recently shared a few sneakpeaks of this stage, it’s a city for our Animal Rivals to compete, race and have lots of fun! Here are some screenshots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/25f40bafa3805a1140cf79bc653b3acf8cc48c72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/c535d6c228521e7c738a809a749aee0b59166a62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/ea9504d8ad63581d56b800d324d1c7daf236f6ea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/87cf24fb92b00e13e09d9b532c29f04add196e9d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/ba7f8d6e4f4a4c81fd04810dcfd031398099fbe4.png[/img]

All of our stages are products of passion and we want to hear your insight. What do you think of our city - [i]Animalonia[/i]? Let us know in the comments!

[h2]Enemy Indicators[/h2]

Latest build gets an implementation of enemy indicators. It’s an important feature, as it allows the player to have an idea how close to you is your animal rival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/29ad731549b6e568b59d7e38101751797064fb62.png[/img]

As you can see, indicators are around our plane showing where our rivals are at!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/6cb6cf88624402d279c093ba5ad9bb85a51f9f10.png[/img]

This feature (hopefully!) will prevent many crashes with other players, but who knows, maybe it’s an advantage to force a fight in the air? Time will tell!

Time is running short, and we still have a lot to do before the final release of the game, but we are on an amazing track! We encourage you to test the demo of the game that is available on the Steam page, and let us know what you think and how you think - we can improve the experience! Fly safe, Beasts!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Beasts![/h1]

We have wonderful news for you today! We revamped some stuff, got a new incredible map, and much more interesting stuff, so buckle up and let’s get right into it!

[h2]Clockworks - New map![/h2]

Clockworks stage is the newest addition in our map pool in Animal Rivals: Up In The Air!
It’s a huge map situated in a clock tower with lots of s-p-o-o-k-y things, like spiders, cogwebs, bridges and more, so you will have a LOT to explore. We can’t wait to release the game and show you more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/07dd26f2749bb3570f42632ef57a5f3185246da7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/c94915a2705e3380df41fb23eea22482aae2c798.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/20a52150fb2ba0cbb6dbff8739401d4dfd037f5e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/e31fcb918a64568cc61e24b999d8af7b8abb156a.png[/img]

[h2]Rings Particle Update[/h2]

We needed to upgrade our particle system in rings, so we did! And we want to hear your feedback. We think it looks incredible, let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/eb56d0f9282dcfd18a7c13953fe310b6ccb7cef9.png[/img]

[h2]Shark Particle System Update[/h2]

We also had a chance to revamp a weapon for our lovely animal - shark! Look how smooth it looks, we can’t wait for you to use it against your animal rivals! Trust us - this one will bring you much fun while eating your friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/b03fa2e9f134aeb032d09a2c20e7b388fef64684.png[/img]

We have A LOT of work on our hands lately, so we are going to wrap this devlog here, because there is much more to come, and we will let you know about all of it soon!
Take care, fly safe and until next time, Beasts!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Beasts![/b][/h1]

Last two weeks were pretty exciting! We had a chance to greatly improve our game and had a lot of fun live streaming it during the Steam Next Festival!

[h2]Steam Next Festival[/h2]

We were taking part in the Steam Next Festival! Events like those are always exciting. We were checking out a lot of new and upcoming games and we had a chance to livestream our newest game, [i]Animal Rivals: Up In The Air![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/305ab62fb0617243a4ecb62979009c558177de01.jpg[/img]

Overall we had a pretty good evening, our game gathered some audience and we had a lot of fun chatting and watching new features in our game.

[h2]Sunset Bridge Stage Update[/h2]

Ah, Sunset Bridge… It looks wonderful, doesn’t it? So, to make this gorgeous map even more fun, we made a fun addition to this map. Sunset Bridge currently has two completely different tracks! To make this even more exciting, one more track is coming soon… fun fact, we plan on having three different tracks for each map, so look out for more info about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/f7bc6a903b56b3b6722416503da500742a6defc3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/281e604d9bcf77144ba397eabe0cd3d55be5a978.png[/img]

[h2]Retro Stage Visual Update[/h2]

Constant improvement is our goal and priority. Our biggest goal is to give players the best looking content we can! So, what do we have to talk about?
Retro Stage needed some love, so we updated the visuals and added some new stuff, our newest addition to the map is… a circus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/7417e5ec21a5785c03e863c8e3f131fde8dc1238.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/4cd709c79ddb9f66d73597c775ef2017f55ebc97.png[/img]

[h2]Particle System Update[/h2]

We also had time to update and upgrade our particle system for the flamethrower, check out how clean and sharp it looks now! Flamethrower to the right is the new and updated one, while the left one is an old one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/f98c8e20170a7ba88e23017ae0f33b455dbf0812.jpg[/img]

There will be more and more to talk about soon as we are approaching the release of the game! Isn’t it exciting?! We for sure are excited!

That’s going to be a wrap for this update, be safe out there, and fly to the sky, Beasts!

notes.title: Animal Rivals: Up In The Air Next Fest Live Stream
notes.content:
Watch game developers play Animal Rivals: Up In The Air! 
Animal Rivals: Up In The Air is a party game with ridiculous graphics. The game will let you dive into racing courses set in the air. Invite your friends and get together into the addictive quadratic animals' world!
The game will offer over 100 customizable parts for you to create the most unique airplane this world has ever seen. This is not the end though – every item will have its effect on the airplane, by changing its statistics like speed, braking or turn values, but if you don`t like to sacrifice this gorgeous propeller for the more powerful one you can simply turn off the statistics before a match!
You will have an opportunity to choose between 9 animal characters. Each one of them will have its own special weapon not available for the others. Choose between predators like the shark, the tiger, the lazy lion or the muscular rat. You can also choose some clumsy hippo, crab or crocodile, but this is not everything - we have got you covered with some sleepy tortoise and even the gangsta pig!
Enjoy the game by playing with AI or bring the friends of yours by playing in local multiplayer mode. You can play up to 4 players locally to find out who is the best pilot in your room!
Not getting enough challenge by playing locally? Try the online multiplayer with up to 8 players fighting for the best pilot title! Show them who is the best!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Beasts![/b]

Today we’re flying by with fascinating news about the upcoming game, Animal Rivals: Up In The Air! Are you excited? Because we certainly are!

Before we “fly with news”, we would like to thank those who wishlisted our games on Steam! We are very happy that you are interested in our ideas and work, and we promise to deliver the best gaming experience we can!

So, what do we have to show off today?

[h2]New scoreboard[/h2]

We completely revamped and improved the scoreboard to be more clear to the player, and to be fair - admit it, it looks cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/f47d06ca6a87aa83069d0761bc69ddb882a87bcd.png[/img]


[h2]Angular Acceleration Boost[/h2]

We were thinking about improving the gameplay loop. We came up with a cool mechanic, and achieved a cool addition to the gameplay with angular acceleration boost. 

How to use this boost? Check out the screenshot and notice the red arrow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/d36cf1603776bf874db9a3f50592b25fc89296d6.jpg[/img]

This is an indicator that you need to fly perpendicular to the arrow to achieve the boost, easy to learn, but hard to master! Remember, there can be circles that will require more control in the air than others (like above one).

[h2]Planes presentation[/h2]

We have to mention a cool detail we have in the game. Everytime you start a match, you are presented with a cool look at your plane (and a sneak peak to other planes of other players!).

It’s an amazing feature to see your plane up close after your precious time spent to check every nook and cranny on it! Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40562697/59bb2670f0a91b4665338e428ab3e9d761cf34d8.jpg[/img]

We are currently looking up to the sky with all the features we want to ensure - are perfectly executed. Let's fly to the sky and until next time, Beasts!
